subject: After installing Stan other R packages start giving error: "there is no package called ‘Rcpp’"

messages.author: 276beb20b840713c
messages.subject: After installing Stan other R packages start giving error: "there is no package called ‘Rcpp’"
parts:
I installed Stan & Rstan on Windows(8) and the installation seems to be working. The 8 schools example and other demos run without error.

However the instalation process seems to have had a nasty side effect: A lot of my previously working R Packages now fail to load and give the following error message: 

library(ggplot2)
Error in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]) : 
  there is no package called ‘Rcpp’
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘ggplot2’

Anyone else facing this? Any idea how to fix this?

It's not just ggplot that complains but I tried some other packages and they fail too. e.g. reshape2

messages.subject: Re: After installing Stan other R packages start giving error: "there is no package called ‘Rcpp’"
parts:
On Tuesday, March 21, 2017 at 10:11:43 PM UTC-4, RN wrote:
I installed Stan & Rstan on Windows(8) and the installation seems to be working. The 8 schools example and other demos run without error.

However the instalation process seems to have had a nasty side effect: A lot of my previously working R Packages now fail to load and give the following error message: 

library(ggplot2)
Error in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]) : 
  there is no package called ‘Rcpp’
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘ggplot2’

Anyone else facing this? Any idea how to fix this?

My guess is that it is autoloading old stanfit object in the .RData file that gets created when you quit R and accidentally click yes when it asks you if you want to save your workspace. If you can delete that or start R with the --vanilla flag, it should be fine. Maybe uninstall and reinstall Rcpp.
